title: Iljin Electric Wins Record £104M UK Offshore Wind Cable Contract
content:
Korea Supply Chain Brief · October 2, 2026

Iljin Electric has won an additional £104 million (about ₩187.1 billion) contract for a UK offshore wind transmission project, the company's largest single cable-business contract on record. Combined with an earlier phase, the two awards now total ₩271.6 billion for one project.

CompanyRoleEvidence
Iljin Electric
KRX: 103590		High-voltage underground cable supply and construction for UK offshore wind grid linksReported: company contract announcement, Oct 2, 2026

What's been disclosed

  • Two-phase award: Iljin Electric won an 84.5 billion won contract in July 2026 for the same UK offshore wind project, followed by this additional £104 million (₩187.1 billion) contract awarded in October 2026 — bringing the cumulative total to ₩271.6 billion.
  • Scope: With the new award, Iljin Electric now handles the full construction and cable supply for all high-voltage underground transmission sections linking major UK offshore wind farms to the grid.
  • Track record cited: The company says the win builds on a "long-term supply chain cooperation framework" partnership it secured with a major British power company earlier in 2026.
  • Company statement: Iljin Electric said it will "aggressively pursue major power grid infrastructure projects across the UK and broader Europe," citing its verified 400kV ultra-high-voltage technology and construction capabilities.

Why this matters

The UK government has been pushing an offshore wind-centered grid overhaul to shore up energy security and meet its 2050 carbon-neutrality target, which requires extensive new high-voltage transmission infrastructure. Iljin Electric frames this contract as validation that Korean cable makers can compete in Europe's high-barrier, high-specification ultra-high-voltage power market — a segment historically dominated by European and Japanese suppliers. (Reported)

What's still unconfirmed

The specific UK offshore wind farm(s) and transmission route(s) covered by the contract were not named in the announcement, nor was a project completion timeline. The exact exchange rate used to convert the £104 million figure, and whether further phases of the same project remain to be awarded, were also not specified. (Reported)

Quick FAQ

Is this a new project or an extension of an existing one?
An extension. Iljin Electric won an initial 84.5 billion won phase of this UK offshore wind project in July 2026; this October award is a second, larger phase of the same project.

What does Iljin Electric actually supply?
Based on current reporting, high-voltage underground transmission cable and construction work connecting offshore wind farms to the UK grid, built on its 400kV ultra-high-voltage technology.

Why is a Korean company winning UK grid contracts?
The company points to a 2026 long-term supply chain partnership with a major British power company as having validated its technical reliability ahead of this award.
